title: GeM Completes 10 Years with ₹20 Lakh Crore GMV
summary: India’s Government e-Marketplace (GeM) completed 10 years of operations on 9 August 2026. The Ministry of Commerce and Industry stated on 7 August 2026 that GeM had facilitated a cumulative Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) of over ₹20 lakh cro...

blocks.content: India’s Government e-Marketplace (GeM) completed 10 years of operations on 9 August 2026. The Ministry of Commerce and Industry stated on 7 August 2026 that GeM had facilitated a cumulative Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) of over ₹20 lakh crore through more than 3.78 crore orders.

items: GeM stands for Government e-Marketplace and is India’s public procurement portal.
Gross Merchandise Value, or GMV, is the total value of goods and services transacted on a platform.
Micro and Small Enterprises are classified under the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises framework in India.
GeM was launched in 2016 and completed 10 years on 9 August 2026.
